scope.summary: Implement the deduped color models: RGB (additive three-channel working/display; 8/16/32-bit), CMYK (four-plate subtractive prepress, device-dependent profile; 8/16-bit), Lab (device-independent L + a/b; 8/16-bit), Gray (single-channel tonal; 8/16/32-bit), Bitmap (1-bit black/white with conversion methods threshold/pattern-diffusion-dither/halftone/custom-pattern), Indexed (palette-limited with palette type, color count, forced colors, transparency, matte, dither, editable color table; 8-bit), Duotone (mono/duo/tri/quadtone inks with per-ink transfer curves + overprint colors; tonal), Multichannel (channel-per-plate special mode; per-plate). Each model backed by ColorEngine (MT-019).
acceptance_criteria: all 8 color models with correct channels + bit depths; Bitmap/Indexed/Duotone/Multichannel structure
expected_tests: test: RGB/CMYK/Lab/Gray/Bitmap/Indexed/Duotone/Multichannel representable with correct channels + allowed bit depths
live: Indexed color table + Duotone ink slots + Bitmap methods round-trip

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Missing color models; prepress + specialized modes unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
